override.effect: the rule's result is recorded under decision; the production runs use dt_fs
override.reason: ±25 % equivalence is too loose against the ~7 % per-temperature precision

rule.counts_toward_production: the run at the chosen time step is the first 1200 K production run: same protocol, independent seed, and a stop that depends only on the total count
rule.design: both runs advance the same number of steps per cycle, so the 4 fs run covers twice the simulated time; with equal rates a 4 fs share q = 2/3 of 800 hops gives a 95 % interval of the ratio of about ×/÷ 1.158, and equal rates pass the rule with probability 0.79 (2,000 simulated checks of the exact rule at 800 hops; 0.67 for a true ratio of 0.9)
rule.rule: use 4 fs if the exact conditional binomial test of the hop counts gives p >= 0.05 and the exact 95 % (Clopper-Pearson) interval of the rate ratio Γ(4 fs)/Γ(2 fs) lies within [0.75, 1.25]; otherwise 2 fs
rule.stop: at the end of the first cycle where the two runs hold at least 800 hops together, or after 50 cycles
